note: Smart IP data-source submodule using the IPInfoDB.com web service. Registers the Smart IP source id 'ipinfodb_web_service' via an event subscriber (SmartIpEventSubscriber extends the parent's SmartIpEventSubscriberBase; sourceId()/configName()). Active only when smart_ip.settings:data_source == 'ipinfodb_web_service'. Own settings live in smart_ip_ipinfodb_web_service.settings (version:int 2|3, default 3; api_key:string required). Lookups call IpinfodbWebService::V2_URL (http://api.ipinfodb.com/v2/ip_query.php) or V3_URL (http://api.ipinfodb.com/v3/ip-city) and need a registered API key, so medium/hard tiers are grounded in the source-selection + version CONFIG (smart_ip.settings + smart_ip_ipinfodb_web_service.settings), never live geolocation calls.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site with the smart_ip_ipinfodb_web_service submodule enabled, which Smart IP config key and value make the IPInfoDB web service the active geolocation data source?
evals.expected_output: Set smart_ip.settings:data_source to 'ipinfodb_web_service' (the source id this submodule contributes). e.g. drush config:set smart_ip.settings data_source ipinfodb_web_service -y.

evals.prompt: What settings does the smart_ip_ipinfodb_web_service submodule store, in which config object, and what do the IPInfoDB API versions differ by?
evals.expected_output: It stores version (integer 2 or 3, default 3) and api_key (required) in the config object smart_ip_ipinfodb_web_service.settings. Version 2 (V2_URL .../v2/ip_query.php) returns a region code; version 3 (V3_URL .../v3/ip-city) removed the region code.

evals.prompt: How does the smart_ip_ipinfodb_web_service submodule plug into Smart IP as a data source — what class does it extend and what identifies the source?
evals.expected_output: It provides an event subscriber SmartIpEventSubscriber that extends the parent Drupal\smart_ip\SmartIpEventSubscriberBase (implements SmartIpDataSourceInterface). sourceId() returns 'ipinfodb_web_service' and configName() returns 'smart_ip_ipinfodb_web_service.settings'; processQuery() maps the IPInfoDB response onto the Smart IP location.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has the IPInfoDB Smart IP data source configured with a specific API version. Inspect the live configuration and report which IPInfoDB API version it is set to.
evals.expected_output: It is set to version 2 (non-default; the shipped default is 3), stored at smart_ip_ipinfodb_web_service.settings:version (read it with drush config:get smart_ip_ipinfodb_web_service.settings version).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure Smart IP to use the IPInfoDB web service (the smart_ip_ipinfodb_web_service submodule) as its active geolocation data source, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set smart_ip.settings:data_source to 'ipinfodb_web_service' (e.g. drush config:set smart_ip.settings data_source ipinfodb_web_service -y). In production you would also store an IPInfoDB api_key; the verify checks only the source selection.
